newsitem.title: GERMANY: World 1996 tapioca imports put at 4.2 mln T.
newsitem.headline: World 1996 tapioca imports put at 4.2 mln T.

text.p: Global imports of tapioca in 1996 rose to 4.22 million tonnes after a sharp fall to 3.58 million in 1995, the independent Oil World newsletter said on Tuesday.
High grain prices boosted imported demand for tapioca in the European Union, especially in the Netherlands, Spain, Belgium, France and Italy.
The additional supplies to the EU came mostly from Thailand and, to a smaller extent, Indonesia.
Thailand exported 3.61 million tonnes to the world market in 1996, compared with 3.30 million in 1995, preliminary figures showed.
Indonesia accounted for 410,000 tonnes, compared with 481,000 tonnes a year earlier, according to an Oil World estimate.
